FundingScaler: Deterministic - applies funding_adjustment_factor based on bias direction vs trade side alignment
LeverageEngine: Deterministic - combines all 5 scalers → final_leverage (1.0-5.0) and position_size_ratio (0.0-1.0)
Paper decision flow: Chain includes dynamic_leverage_engine step after adl_shield and before policy_engine
Decision trace contract: 7 leverage fields - leverage_decision, confidence_multiplier, microstructure_multiplier, liquidation_multiplier, funding_multiplier, final_leverage, position_size_ratio
GET /api/admin/futures/leverage/status: Returns 12 contract fields including leverage_distribution, size_clamp_events, confidence_vs_leverage, liquidation_distance_vs_leverage
System remains paper-only - no live trading execution
